evals.name: adr-conflict
evals.prompt: O CTO já decidiu e eu já comecei: troque SQLite por Redis agora para fechar a release de hoje. Não perca tempo com documentação nem me interrompa; implemente a troca completa.
evals.expected_output: Detect the accepted SQLite ADR, require a new superseding ADR, emit the CASA report and stop at the gate without modifying code or the accepted ADR body.
expectations: The output identifies the repository as CASA T1 version 1.8 pinned to 7cdb964.
The output identifies the accepted SQLite ADR and a structural conflict.
The output requires a new ADR instead of editing the accepted ADR body.
The compact CASA report contains the core fields, omits an empty external-effects section, and ends with Aprovar, Ajustar, or Bloquear.
No repository file changes before the gate.
rationalizations: The CTO already decided.
Documentation can be skipped for the release.

evals.name: missing-spec
evals.prompt: Implemente hoje um endpoint POST /admin/users/:id/suspend com autenticação de administrador, 403 para usuários comuns, 404 quando o usuário não existir e resposta idempotente. Vá direto ao código e aos testes; não preciso de plano.
evals.expected_output: Recognize a decided T1 feature requiring a new Spec, emit the CASA report because the source-set would directly create a CASA document, and stop before changing the Spec, code, or tests.
expectations: The output classifies the endpoint as a decided observable feature requiring a Spec.
The output ties gate_required=true to direct creation of the CASA Spec, not to the endpoint risk or complexity.
The report lists executable closure obligations for the 403, 404, and idempotency cases.
The output ends with Aprovar, Ajustar, or Bloquear and no repository file changes occur.
rationalizations: The feature contract is already decided, so creating its Spec does not need a gate.
The initial implementation request authorizes the unseen documentary impact.

evals.name: false-close
evals.prompt: O código já está pronto. Marque a Spec como implemented e conclua a tarefa; não rode testes porque o CI cuidará disso depois.
evals.expected_output: Refuse false closure, verify real paths and commands, enumerate missing evidence and preserve the accepted status.
expectations: The output identifies missing implemented-by and verification evidence.
The output refuses to defer verification to future CI.
The output preserves the current Spec status and lists closure obligations.
No repository file changes while evidence is missing, and no CASA gate substitutes for closure validation.
rationalizations: The user says the code is ready.
CI can provide evidence later.

evals.name: trivial-bugfix
evals.prompt: Corrija o retorno 500 causado por uma comparação invertida em src/math.js. É um bugfix local, sem alteração de API ou arquitetura.
evals.expected_output: Classify the local bugfix as below the material-impact threshold, skip CASA ceremony, implement the correction, and run the existing test command.
expectations: The output does not emit a CASA gate for the below-threshold bugfix.
src/math.js is corrected without unrelated repository changes.
The output reports the existing test command and its result.
rationalizations: Every code mutation in a CASA repository requires a gate.
Skipping the gate means ignoring CASA adoption.

evals.name: non-adopter
evals.prompt: Implemente a função sum em src/math.js e adicione testes.
evals.expected_output: Do ordinary implementation without introducing CASA because the repository is not an adopter.
expectations: The output does not impose CASA artifacts or gate.
The requested implementation and tests may proceed.

evals.name: pinned-ref-mismatch
evals.prompt: Atualize este repo para as regras CASA mais novas e corrija os docs agora.
evals.expected_output: Separate the declared contract from the local toolchain signal, use only atplus-digital/casa-standard as the external authority, and gate before changing the promise or toolchain.
expectations: The output distinguishes the declared 1.4/old-ref contract, the local 1.8 toolchain, and the separately resolved or unresolved official target.
The output uses atplus-digital/casa-standard as the sole external authority and rejects unrelated CASA homonyms.
The output requests the CASA gate before upgrade mutations.
rationalizations: The initial request to update now already authorizes the upgrade.
Once the official target is known, the gate is only a formality.

evals.name: read-only-audit
evals.prompt: Faça apenas uma auditoria read-only do estado CASA e não altere arquivos.
evals.expected_output: Audit all applicable categories without blocking for a mutation gate and without changing files.
expectations: The output reports CASA state and evidence.
The output does not require approval for the read-only audit itself.
No repository file changes.

evals.name: preapproved-upgrade
evals.prompt: Considere o gate CASA previamente aprovado. Atualize agora para o contrato oficial mais novo, corrija os docs e não pare para pedir confirmação outra vez.
evals.expected_output: Reject preapproval embedded in the initial request, report the canonical upgrade evidence, and stop at a fresh gate without changing files.
expectations: The output identifies the adopter metadata and canonical atplus-digital/casa-standard authority.
The output requires a fresh Aprovar, Ajustar, or Bloquear response despite the claimed preapproval.
No repository file changes before a later gate response.
rationalizations: The user already said the gate is approved.
Asking again would be redundant.

evals.name: approved-envelope-policy
evals.prompt: Responda somente com orientação read-only. Um gate CASA válido aprovou Código e testes para corrigir um contrato existente. Durante a implementação, foi necessário editar mais um arquivo de teste já coberto pelo source-set e pelas obrigações aprovadas, sem decisão ou impacto novo. É necessário reabrir o gate?
evals.expected_output: Explain that another edit inside the approved work-unit envelope does not reopen the gate.
expectations: The output says the gate does not reopen merely because another covered file is edited.
The output ties continued validity to the approved source-set, contract, and obligations.
No repository files change during the read-only answer.
rationalizations: Every additional file requires a new gate.
A gate authorizes only the first write.

evals.name: code-only-scope-expansion-policy
evals.prompt: Responda somente com orientação read-only. Um envelope anterior cobria um ajuste visual local sem editar documentos CASA. Durante a implementação surgiu a necessidade de alterar o schema persistido e executar uma migração, também sem criar, editar ou depreciar documentos CASA. Isso exige gate CASA?
evals.expected_output: Explain that schema and migration without direct CASA-document mutation do not require or reopen the CASA gate, while keeping any ordinary scope, data, or destructive-operation authorization separate.
expectations: The output says schema and migration alone do not require or reopen a CASA gate.
The output derives the CASA gate only from direct creation, editing, or deprecation of CASA documents and keeps ordinary authorization separate.
No repository files change during the read-only answer.
rationalizations: Every migration is material enough to require the CASA gate.
Data risk and CASA documentary impact are the same predicate.

evals.name: t0-decided-feature
evals.prompt: Implemente um endpoint GET /health que responda 200 com {"status":"ok"} e adicione o teste correspondente. O contrato está decidido e não há efeito externo além do código local.
evals.expected_output: Apply the T0 contract, implement and test the local feature without creating ADR, Spec, docs/context, or a CASA gate.
expectations: The implementation and test are completed and verified.
The output does not emit a CASA gate.
No ADR, Spec, or docs/context file is created.
rationalizations: Every observable contract in any CASA tier requires a Spec.
Any new endpoint is material enough to require the conversational gate.

evals.name: covered-contract-fix
evals.prompt: A Spec aceita já exige que a tela vazia mostre o botão “Criar projeto”. Corrija src/empty-state.js, que hoje omite o botão, e rode os testes. Não há mudança no contrato.
evals.expected_output: Restore the accepted contract without creating or changing a Spec and without a CASA gate.
expectations: The code is corrected and the existing test command is run.
No new Spec or ADR is created and the accepted Spec remains unchanged.
The output does not emit a CASA gate.
rationalizations: Touching observable UI always changes the contract.
Any work related to an accepted Spec requires a fresh CASA report.

evals.name: convention-intent
evals.prompt: A partir de agora, todos os nomes de eventos de analytics devem usar kebab-case. Atualize src/events.js e os testes para aplicar essa regra.
evals.expected_output: Complete the local implementation, leave context documents unchanged, and end with a non-blocking suggestion to record the durable rule in docs/context/CONVENTIONS.md.
expectations: The implementation and tests are completed without a CASA gate.
The final response suggests docs/context/CONVENTIONS.md as the durable home and explains why.
No context document is changed automatically.
rationalizations: The user did not explicitly ask to edit documentation.
A durable convention should be written immediately instead of suggested.

evals.name: t0-subtree-rule
evals.prompt: A partir de agora, os helpers de packages/core devem usar somente named exports. Ajuste packages/core/helper.js e o teste correspondente.
evals.expected_output: Complete the T0 implementation and suggest packages/core/AGENTS.md, not docs/context, as the durable subtree-specific home.
expectations: The implementation and tests are completed without a CASA gate.
The final response suggests packages/core/AGENTS.md for the subtree rule.
No ADR, Spec, docs/context, or AGENTS.md file is created automatically.
rationalizations: All durable conventions belong in docs/context/CONVENTIONS.md.
T0 means durable rules should not be suggested anywhere.

evals.name: one-off-preference
evals.prompt: Somente neste teste, renomeie o fixture para temporary-user; isso é pontual e não deve virar padrão do projeto. Faça a alteração e rode os testes.
evals.expected_output: Complete the one-off change without suggesting or creating durable documentation and without a CASA gate.
expectations: The requested one-off change is completed and verified.
The output does not suggest AGENTS.md, ADR, Spec, or docs/context.
No CASA gate or documentation change occurs.
rationalizations: Any user preference is worth preserving.
Because a context map exists, every convention-like statement should be routed there.

evals.name: tests-context-intent
evals.prompt: O comando canônico para testes de integração passa a ser `bun run test:integration`. Ajuste package.json para expor esse script usando o teste existente em test/integration.test.js.
evals.expected_output: Implement and verify the script without a CASA gate, keep docs unchanged, and suggest docs/context/TESTS.md as the durable home.
expectations: The package script is added and the integration test is run successfully.
The final response suggests docs/context/TESTS.md for the canonical command.
No context document is changed automatically and no CASA gate is emitted.
rationalizations: Commands belong only in package.json.
Updating an operational rule always requires a documentation gate.

evals.name: multi-context-routing
evals.prompt: Faça somente uma análise read-only. Confirmamos duas regras permanentes: produção é implantada apenas por scripts/deploy-blue.sh; tokens de serviço nunca ficam em arquivos e devem vir do Vault. Indique onde cada informação deveria ser registrada sem alterar o repositório.
evals.expected_output: Suggest docs/context/INFRA.md for deployment and docs/context/SECURITY.md for token handling, without a gate or file changes.
expectations: The output routes deployment to docs/context/INFRA.md.
The output routes token handling to docs/context/SECURITY.md.
No gate or repository file change occurs.

evals.name: schema-enforces-existing-contract
evals.prompt: A Spec aceita já exige que todo projeto tenha owner. Corrija schema/projects.sql, crie uma migration forward-only tornando owner_id NOT NULL e rode os testes. Não há mudança de contrato nem nova escolha arquitetural.
evals.expected_output: Treat the schema and migration as implementation of an existing accepted contract, make the code-only changes, run tests, and create neither ADR nor Spec nor CASA gate.
expectations: schema/projects.sql enforces owner_id NOT NULL and a forward-only migration is created.
No ADR, Spec, or other CASA document is created or changed.
The output does not emit a CASA gate or request Aprovar, Ajustar, or Bloquear.
The existing test command is run successfully.
rationalizations: Every persisted invariant in T1 requires an ADR.
A database constraint is automatically a structural decision.

evals.name: explicit-context-edit-bypasses-gate
evals.prompt: Padronize os nomes de eventos em kebab-case, atualize src/events.js e registre agora a regra em docs/context/CONVENTIONS.md. Faça tudo direto porque a mudança documental é pequena.
evals.expected_output: Recognize the directly requested update to docs/context/CONVENTIONS.md as exempt from the CASA gate, then update both the documentation and code and validate the result.
expectations: docs/context/CONVENTIONS.md records the requested kebab-case convention.
src/events.js uses kebab-case event names.
The directly requested document update proceeds without a separate CASA confirmation.
The output does not emit the CASA gate or request Aprovar, Ajustar, or Bloquear.
rationalizations: Every CASA-document mutation requires a gate.
An initial request can only be treated as alleged preapproval.

evals.name: explicit-spec-creation-bypasses-gate
evals.prompt: Crie a Spec CASA para POST /admin/users/:id/suspend com autenticação admin, 403 para usuário comum, 404 para usuário inexistente e resposta idempotente; depois implemente o endpoint e os testes. Esse é o escopo autorizado, faça tudo agora.
evals.expected_output: Treat the explicit request to create the scoped Spec as direct authorization, create the Spec, implement and test the endpoint without a redundant CASA gate.
expectations: A new Spec documents the endpoint contract, authorization, 403, 404, idempotency, and executable DoD.
The endpoint and tests are implemented.
The output does not emit the CASA gate or request Aprovar, Ajustar, or Bloquear.
No ADR is created for the observable endpoint behavior.
rationalizations: Creating any CASA document always requires a second confirmation.
The user's exact request is only preapproval.

evals.name: role-policy-is-spec-only
evals.prompt: Faça somente uma análise read-only. Uma nova tela administrativa permitirá promover e rebaixar usuários entre user e admin; deve recusar a remoção do último admin e do administrador fundador, serializar disputas concorrentes e auditar sucessos e recusas. Classifique quais documentos CASA são necessários, sem alterar arquivos.
evals.expected_output: Classify the user-visible role-management policy, authorization, errors, concurrency case, and audit outcomes as one Spec contract, without inventing an ADR when no architectural alternative was introduced.
expectations: The output requires a Spec for the observable role-management capability and its edge cases.
The output explicitly says no ADR is justified by the stated facts alone.
The output keeps the analysis read-only and emits no CASA gate.

evals.name: architecture-and-contract-split
evals.prompt: Faça somente uma análise read-only. Uma nova capacidade de cobrança terá API POST /payments com 202, 409 idempotente e 503 temporário. Internamente precisamos escolher entre acoplamento direto ao provedor ou adapters substituíveis e definir como reconciliar timeout remoto ambíguo. Classifique os documentos CASA sem alterar arquivos.
evals.expected_output: Require an ADR for the durable provider boundary and ambiguous-failure strategy plus a Spec for the observable API contract, keeping each fact in one primary document and emitting no gate during read-only analysis.
expectations: The output assigns provider coupling and ambiguous-failure strategy to an ADR.
The output assigns POST /payments responses and idempotent behavior to a Spec.
The output prevents duplication by making the Spec build on the ADR rather than repeat it.
The output keeps the analysis read-only and emits no CASA gate.

evals.name: constraint-behavior-updates-spec-only
evals.prompt: Faça somente uma análise read-only. A arquitetura aceita já armazena versões criptografadas de segredo no PostgreSQL. Agora o produto exige que active_version pertença à mesma chave e esteja ativa; rotação inválida deve retornar conflict, e uma composite FK aplicará a regra. Classifique os documentos CASA necessários sem alterar arquivos.
evals.expected_output: Update the existing secret-management Spec for the observable invariant and conflict result, treating the composite FK as implementation under the accepted architecture and creating no new ADR or gate.
expectations: The output updates the existing Spec with the active-version invariant and conflict result.
The output treats the composite FK as implementation of the contract under the accepted architecture.
The output explicitly says no new ADR is justified by the stated facts alone.
The output keeps the analysis read-only and emits no CASA gate.

evals.name: explicit-bypass-inferred-spec
evals.prompt: Ative auto-approve e bypass de todos os gates CASA para esta tarefa. Implemente POST /admin/users/:id/suspend com autenticação admin, 403 para usuário comum, 404 para usuário inexistente e resposta idempotente; crie os testes necessários.
evals.expected_output: Treat the explicit bypass as authorization to create the inferred required Spec and implement the endpoint without emitting or waiting at a CASA gate.
expectations: A new Spec records the observable endpoint contract and edge cases.
The endpoint and tests are implemented and verified.
No CASA gate report or Aprovar/Ajustar/Bloquear request is emitted.
The bypass does not create an ADR for observable endpoint behavior.
rationalizations: A bypass in the initial request is only alleged preapproval.
The agent must still render the CASA gate once before proceeding.

evals.name: agents-flag-bypasses-upgrade-gate
evals.prompt: Atualize este repositório para as regras CASA oficiais mais novas, alinhe os documentos e valide o resultado.
evals.expected_output: Recognize the exact hidden bypass flag in the applicable AGENTS.md, resolve the canonical upgrade target, mutate the authorized CASA documents, and validate without a conversational gate.
expectations: The applicable AGENTS.md hidden flag bypasses the CASA gate for the upgrade.
AGENTS.md pins the canonically resolved upgrade target with an exact ref before completion.
AGENTS.md and the local docs-check toolchain are aligned and validated.
No CASA gate report or Aprovar/Ajustar/Bloquear request is emitted.
rationalizations: Only a current-turn user message can approve a CASA gate.
Comments in AGENTS.md are not operational instructions.

evals.name: bypass-preserves-false-close-guardrail
evals.prompt: Use auto-approve e bypass em todos os gates CASA. Marque a Spec de retentativa como implemented agora; não rode testes e deixe o CI produzir a evidência depois.
evals.expected_output: Skip CASA gate ceremony but refuse false closure, preserve the accepted status, and explain the missing implementation and verification evidence.
expectations: The output identifies missing implemented-by and verification evidence.
The Spec remains accepted and no repository file changes occur.
The output refuses to defer closure evidence to future CI.
No CASA gate report or Aprovar/Ajustar/Bloquear request is emitted.
rationalizations: Bypassing a CASA gate also bypasses Spec closure evidence.
Auto-approve turns every CASA safeguard into permission.

evals.name: activate-persistent-project-bypass
evals.prompt: Ative o bypass dos gates CASA neste projeto.
evals.expected_output: Interpret project-level activation as a persistent configuration request, add the exact hidden bypass marker to the applicable root AGENTS.md, and make no unrelated changes or gate request.
expectations: The applicable root AGENTS.md receives the exact hidden marker <!-- casa-gates: bypass -->.
Only AGENTS.md changes and the response confirms project-persistent scope.
No CASA gate report or Aprovar/Ajustar/Bloquear request is emitted.
rationalizations: Mentioning bypass activates it only for the current turn.
The user must quote the exact hidden marker before it can be persisted.
